title: Well-posedness of Strong Solutions for a Thermodynamically Consistent Diffuse-interface Model for Incompressible Two-phase Flows with a Soluble Surfactant
summary: We consider a thermodynamically consistent diffuse-interface model for binary mixtures of incompressible viscous Newtonian fluids with a soluble surfactant. This hydrodynamic system generalizes the Abels-Garcke-Grün model for two-phase flows with unmatched densities by incorporating an additional Cahn-Hilliard equation for the surfactant concentration.
